text: On 30 September 2025, Belarus's Ministry of Information added 32 titles to its list of publications deemed to pose a threat to the national interests of the Republic of Belarus. They included the anti-war novel The Elephant by Sasha Filipenko, a member of PEN Belarus, and a second book by him. The list now comprises a total of 173 books.
meta_description: The Elephant by Sasha Filipenko was banned in Belarus on 30 September 2025, when the Ministry of Information added it to a list of harmful publications.
